name: West Ridge
approach: From the standard Chair Peak trailhead used for the Northeast Buttress (Alpental lot), traverse slabby terrain that can be snowy and glide-cracked in early season to reach the base of the route, roughly 2-2.5 hours from the parking area.

waypoints.name: Alpental parking lot / Snow Lake TH #1013
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 52 (Snoqualmie Pass West), head north under the freeway onto Alpental Road and follow it about 1.3 miles to its end at the Alpental ski area parking lot, where the Snow Lake Trail #1013 begins. A Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Chair Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the Snow Lake Trail to the signed unmaintained spur toward Source Lake and take climbers' paths upslope toward Chair Peak, the same start as the Northeast Buttress. Traverse slabby ground, snowy and glide-cracked early in the season, round onto the west side to a 220 ft couloir below the ridge's low point just east of a distinct tower. Climb the couloir, then follow the crest to the summit.
